answer: Sponsor liability: a new agent earns only after an established sponsor commits its single non-splittable slot token, called a marble, to it. Each sponsor owns one marble, so a farm needs a separate established accomplice per fake seat. Across a six-epoch horizon the sponsor's own rewards are escrowed against the invitee; if a canary audit shows the invitee duplicating another seat's work, that escrow burns and the marble stays frozen until the horizon ends. A comet, meaning a cluster of seats registered in one block from one origin, triggers that audit.
